## Part 2

Variables included in the non-survey model:

- `LATNUM` Cluster latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84)
  - PREPROCESSING HERE
- `LONGNUM` Cluster longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84)
  - PREPROCESSING HERE
- `ALT_DEM` Cluster elevation in meters above sea level from Digital Elevation Model 
- `URBAN_RURA` Cluster urban/rural designation (`"U"` = Urban, `"R"` = Rural)


+ LONGNUM + ALT_DEM + URBAN_RURA + spei_mean_utero + spei_mean_yr1 + spei_mean_yr2 + spei_mean_rec + drought_share_utero + drought_share_yr1 + drought_share_yr2 + drought_share_rec + crop_ha_mean + staple_ha_mean + rainfed_ha + rainfed_share,

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

results <- load("/Users/gavinaligondalwala/ppol6803/final_project/PPOL-670_Final-Project/results.RData")

# Countries included per year
kids_train |>
  group_by(cc) |>
  summarise(year = min(v007)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, group = cc)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "purple", color = "darkblue" ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2012, 2025, by = 1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cc), stat = "count",
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Survey start year",
       y = "Number of countries",
       title = "Countries included in each DHS Survey year",
       caption = "Source: Demographic and Health Surveys Program",
       ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Distribution of heights

###
kids_train |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(x = haz), kernel = "gaussian")+
  labs(
    x = "Height-for-age z-score",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Height-for-age Z-score across SSA",
    subtitle = "0 is the global median and −2 is the stunting cutoff",
    caption = "Source: Demographic and Health Surveys Program"
    )
###

med_haz <- median(kids_train$haz, na.rm = TRUE)

kids_train |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(x = haz), kernel = "gaussian") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_haz, color = "firebrick") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -2, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Height-for-age z-score",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Height-for-age Z-score across SSA",
    subtitle = "0 is the global median and −2 is the stunting cutoff",
    caption = "Source: Demographic and Health Surveys Program"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
